lines: There's a cave the size of a car hiding under this geyser.
There's a CAVE the size of a CAR hiding under this geyser.
Wait. A cave? Under Old Faithful?!
Wait. A CAVE? Under Old Faithful?!
Yep. And that little cave is the reason rangers can tell you when it'll blow next.
Yep. And that little cave is why rangers can tell you when it'll BLOW next.
Okay, so where is this thing?
Okay, so WHERE is this thing?
Yellowstone, in the US. Around half of all the geysers on Earth are right here. And this one shoots boiling water higher than a fifteen-storey building.
YELLOWSTONE, in the US. Around HALF of all the geysers on Earth are right here. And this one shoots boiling water higher than a 15-STOREY building.
Scientists actually lowered a camera down the hole. About twenty feet down, the pipe squeezes to just a few inches wide.
Scientists actually lowered a CAMERA down the hole. About 20 FEET down, the pipe squeezes to just a FEW INCHES wide.
A few inches? For all that water?
A few INCHES? For ALL that water?
And right below that... the cave. About as big as a small car.
And right below that... the CAVE. About as big as a small CAR.
Oh, so it's like a pressure cooker! Rain and snow soak into the ground, magma, that's melted rock, heats it way past boiling... but all the water on top stops it from bubbling.
Oh, so it's like a PRESSURE COOKER! Rain and snow soak into the ground, MAGMA, that's melted rock, heats it WAY past boiling... but all the water on TOP stops it from bubbling.
Exactly! Then a little spills out the top, the pressure drops, and boom. It all turns to steam at once.
Exactly! Then a little SPILLS out the top, the pressure DROPS, and BOOM. It all turns to STEAM at once.
Okay, but how do rangers know when it's coming?
Okay, but how do rangers KNOW when it's coming?
They just time it! A short eruption means a shorter wait for the next one. A long eruption? You'll be waiting longer.
They just TIME it! A SHORT eruption means a SHORTER wait for the next one. A LONG eruption? You'll be waiting LONGER.
Most of the time, they're right within about ten minutes. All thanks to a car-sized cave you'll never see.
Most of the time, they're right within about 10 MINUTES. All thanks to a CAR-SIZED cave you'll never see.
Follow for a new wonder every day!
FOLLOW for a new wonder every day!
